events.description:
AUDITION INFORMATION Monday, November 30, 2026 | 6:00–9:00 PM Location: 2nd Floor Dance Studio, May Hall Callbacks: Tuesday, December 1 | 6:00–9:00 PM Cast Announcement: Thursday, December 3 SIGN UP FOR YOUR AUDITION TIME! https://www.signupgenius.com/go/5080F44A5AA2AA6F49-67605085-clue Please plan to arrive about 15 minutes before your scheduled audition time.

WHAT DO I NEED TO PREPARE? Not much! If you have a comedic monologue you'd like to perform, wonderful! We would love to see it. Don't have a monologue? NO PROBLEM! We'll have selections from the Clue script available for you to read during auditions. We're looking for people who are willing to have fun, make bold choices, and bring some personality to the stage. You do NOT need previous theatre experience to audition!

MEET THE SUSPECTS! We have some fantastic characters to bring to life!Wadsworth: The uptight British butler desperately trying to keep everything under control.

Yvette: The loyal and alluring French maid.

Miss Scarlet: A sharp-tongued socialite who always seems to know more than she's saying.

Mrs. Peacock: A wealthy senator's wife who has a flair for the dramatic.

Mrs. White: A mysterious widow with a rather questionable marital history.

Colonel Mustard: A pompous military man who might not be quite as clever as he thinks.

Professor Plum: An arrogant academic who is definitely his own biggest fan.

Mr. Green: An anxious, nervous rule follower who seems to be hiding something.

AND THERE ARE MORE ROLES! We're also looking for performers to take on ensemble roles, including Mr. Boddy, the Cook, the Motorist, the Singing Telegram Girl, police officers, and more! These are great opportunities to have fun with different characters and get involved in the production.

IMPORTANT PRODUCTION DATES Rehearsals Begin: January 4, 2027 Performances: February 19–21, 2027 Regular rehearsals will take place Sunday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday evenings from 6:00–9:00 PM. We will also have a scheduled break January 17–21 for KCACTF.

COME JOIN US! One of my favorite things about the Blue Hawk Theatre Guild is that you don't have to be a theatre major to get involved. We have students from all different majors and backgrounds who come together to create something pretty incredible. If you've ever thought about trying theatre, THIS IS YOUR CHANCE! Come meet some new people, challenge yourself, earn some potential college credit, and help us put on a hilarious show. We would love to see some new faces alongside our returning Guild members!

events.title: Books & Banter: "A Christmas Carol" by Charles Dickens
events.description:
“Books and Banter,” a monthly book club featuring Victorian-era literature, will meet Tuesday, Dec. 15, 9-10 a.m. MT at the Chateau de Morès Interpretive Center in Medora. Book selections are intended to be easy to read and fun to discuss. Coffee and tea will be provided.

This month’s book, “A Christmas Carol” by Charles Dickens, tells the story of Ebenezer Scrooge, a bitter man who changes his ways after visits from three ghosts. Through their lessons, he learns kindness, generosity, and the true meaning of Christmas. This Victorian novella helped establish Christmas traditions in Great Britain and beyond. The book is available to read for free via Project Gutenberg.

When the State Historical Society of North Dakota took possession of the Chateau de Morès, it held a library so extensive that locals would borrow its books. The subjects of these books range from poems to military tactics, early childhood education to romance novels, and animal husbandry to human medical care.

This event is part of the ND250 commemoration celebrating our country’s 250th birthday.

For more information, contact Outreach Coordinator Shelby Reidle, shschateau@nd.gov or 701.623.4355. The Chateau de Morès State Historic Site is managed by the State Historical Society of North Dakota. The Chateau de Morès Interpretive Center hours are Tuesday-Saturday, 9 a.m.-5 p.m., and closed Sunday-Monday. The home is open by appointment. All times listed are Mountain time. Find information about upcoming programs of the State Historical Society at history.nd.gov/events.

events.title: 2026 Leather & Lace
events.description:
Join us on Thursday, December 31st, for an unforgettable night of rodeo action, live music, and New Year's Eve celebration at the Ag Expo!

The evening will feature some of the best in western sports, including bull riding, women's bronc riding, and bullfighting!

This year's event will also host two major championship competitions: Bull Riding Small Town Showdown Series Championship Women's Ranch Bronc Riding Team World Championship

The rodeo action kicks off at 8:00 PM, bringing big rides, fierce competition, and plenty of excitement to close out 2026!

Once the dust settles, keep the party going with live music from Booz' N' Tuna!

They'll be taking the stage to help us celebrate, dance, and ring in the New Year in true Western fashion.

Whether you're a rodeo fan, a country music lover, or just looking for a fun way to celebrate New Year's Eve, Leather & Lace is the place to be!

🎟️ TICKETS: Tickets can be purchased in person at Saddle Up or at the McKenzie County Ag Expo.

Grab your friends, pull on your boots, and join us December 31st for a night of championship rodeo action and New Year's Eve fun.

Let's send 2026 out with a bang!

This New Year’s Eve celebration is specially designed for middle school and high school students to say goodbye to 2026 and welcome 2027 in the best way possible—with friends, tons of activities, and an energetic vibe in a safe and exciting environment.

Whether you’re shooting hoops on the basketball court, spiking the ball in volleyball, battling it out in laser tag, or leveling up in video games, there’s something for everyone. Plus, enjoy a variety of tasty appetizers and refreshing drinks throughout the night!

When the clock strikes midnight, gather with us to watch the ball drop in style and celebrate the start of a brand new year with your friends. Don’t miss out on the ultimate way to kick off a new year!

Open to all teens in grades 6-12.
